company_info.industry_info: Open source software and operating systems. Canonical is the publisher of Ubuntu, a leading open source platform used in cloud computing, data science, AI, IoT, and enterprise initiatives. The company provides enterprise solutions built on Ubuntu.
company_info.recent_news: May 28, 2026: Canonical announced general availability of optimized Ubuntu images for Google Cloud TPU virtual machines. June 2026: Canonical declared 2026 as the year of Ubuntu Linux on RISC-V, pushing for mainstream adoption across desktop, server, and edge computing. The company continues to expand its AI and infrastructure optimization initiatives.
company_info.company_culture: Remote-first company since 2004 with a distributed workforce across 70+ countries. Teams meet 2-4 times yearly in person at strategic locations. Founder-led and profitable. Culture rating of 4.3/5 on Comparably and 3.3/5 on Glassdoor (444 reviews) with 53% of employees recommending it to friends. Emphasis on work-life balance, learning, and collaboration with talented engineers globally. Company values diversity, equal opportunity, and work-from-home flexibility.
company_info.any_related_information: Canonical is expanding its technical capabilities in AI infrastructure and hardware partnerships (RISC-V). The company focuses on enterprise and technology markets with major customers including leading public cloud and silicon providers. Team sprints held twice yearly provide in-person alignment opportunities. Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year is offered. This role aligns with Canonical's strategic focus on Kubernetes operators and cloud-native technologies.
